questions.question: When King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon was making war on Judah, what did King Zedekiah's men ask Jeremiah to do?

answers.text: Inquire of the LORD for them
Make peace with Babylon for them
Lead the army out for them

questions.question: When Babylon's army surrounded Jerusalem, the LORD told the people who would live. Who was it?
The LORD swore that if the king of Judah did not obey His words, what would the king's house become?
When nations asked why the LORD had done this to the great city of Judah, what reason would people give?

answers.text: They forsook the LORD's covenant and served other gods
They ignored the LORD's prophets and trusted in Egypt
They neglected the LORD's temple and stopped His offerings
